title: Mail & comunicazioni
summary: Product requirements for a LocalMind extension that ingests company mailboxes via IMAP into a weighted people-communications-topics knowledge graph queried via GraphRAG, fully self-hosted.
scope: Graph node types: Persona, Organizzazione, Casella/Account, Messaggio, Thread/Conversazione, Tema/Argomento, Allegato/Documento, Impegno/Action item, Decisione, Evento/Scadenza

Graph relation types: HA_SCRITTO, DESTINATARIO_DI, APPARTIENE_A, RISPONDE_A, COMUNICA_CON, TRATTA, APPARTIENE_A_ORG, COINVOLGE_ORG, CONTIENE_ALLEGATO, CITA_DOCUMENTO, CONTIENE_IMPEGNO, RESPONSABILE_DI, HA_DECISO, SCADE_IL, SIMILE_A
Edge weighting factors: frequenza, recenza/time-decay, direzionalita/ruolo, reciprocita, rilevanza semantica, densita thread, confidenza estrazione, feedback utente, importanza partecipanti

MVP feature set (15): IMAP connector with incremental UID/UIDVALIDITY sync + encrypted credentials; EmailMessage model extension (Message-ID/In-Reply-To/References/Cc/attachments/language); MIME parsing + de-quoting + signature removal; thread reconstruction; attachment extraction via document pipeline (Tika/OCR to Qdrant); local AI enrichment (NER, message/thread summary, classification); person/org entity resolution; communications graph schema on MySQL; content embedding on Qdrant with perimeter filters; base edge weights; REST API for IMAP account mgmt/ingestion status/graph query; GraphRAG with cited answers; UI for account config/persona-org dossier/graph chat; commitment/deadline extraction with mail to-do view; base privacy controls (visibility perimeters, Ollama-only policy)

Data connectors: IMAP (Eclipse Angus Mail, existing email domain), Gmail/Google Workspace IMAP+OAuth2/XOAUTH2, Microsoft 365/Exchange IMAP+OAuth2 (future Graph API), attachments via DocumentIngestionPipelineService (Tika/OCR), shared/functional mailboxes (info@/sales@), messaging domain connectors (Slack/Telegram), calendar domain, .mbox/.eml/PST file import, PF4J CommunicationSourceExtension extension point
GraphRAG ingestion pipeline (IMAP fetch to graph) and query pipeline (question to cited answer)
Personas: account/sales manager, project manager, procurement, founder, knowledge worker, new hire, assistant, IT admin, DPO/compliance
Privacy/governance: PII redaction, retention/oblio, visibility perimeters, consent/purpose, Ollama-only LLM policy
KPIs: coverage >98%, thread reconstruction >95%, NER precision >0.85, entity resolution >0.9, zero data exfiltration
Integration with existing modules: email, knowledge, llm/Ollama, document, vectorstore/Qdrant, MySQL/Flyway, batch, auth, calendar, messaging, automation, agent, marketplace/PF4J, common, frontend
